description: This file defines classes related to MPEG descriptors within the WPEFramework project, including Descriptor and DescriptorIterator classes for handling MPEG descriptor data.

classes.name: Descriptor
classes.description: Represents an MPEG descriptor with methods to access its tag, length, and data.

classes.name: DescriptorIterator
classes.description: Provides iteration over a collection of MPEG descriptors within a data block.

methods.name: Descriptor(const Core::DataElement& data)
methods.description: Constructs a Descriptor from a data element.

methods.name: Tag()
methods.description: Returns the tag of the descriptor.

methods.name: Length()
methods.description: Returns the total length of the descriptor including header.

methods.name: operator[](const uint8_t index)
methods.description: Accesses data byte at specified index within the descriptor.

methods.name: DescriptorIterator(const Core::DataElement& data)
methods.description: Constructs an iterator over a data element containing descriptors.

methods.name: IsValid()
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Reset()
methods.description: Resets the iterator to an invalid state.

methods.name: Next()
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next descriptor.

methods.name: Tag(const uint8_t tagId)
methods.description: Searches for a descriptor with the specified tag.

methods.name: Count()
methods.description: Counts the number of descriptors in the data block.
